name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a single conditional ('If you pick up the key, you must also open the door'), and RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) hard captures exactly that — the 'also' wording gives a no-timing cue, so RespondedExistence rather than Response is correct, 'must' with no preference cue makes it hard, and picking up the key is a condition event, not a goal, so no Existence is required. The empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid for a task whose only requirement is the consequent of an 'if'.

texts: If the agent picks up the matching key, the door must also be opened at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
